_comment: Ground truth for sequential schematics. 'expect' is the macro class the pattern engine should report. 'form' is gate (drawn from gate symbols) or block (labelled box). Read off each drawing by eye - NOT copied from tool output, so a regression cannot silently rewrite the target.
